mechanism: Ketorolac reduces renal clearance and increases serum concentrations of pyrazinamide, while pyrazinamide may increase uric acid levels that ketorolac can further elevate, and NSAIDs impair renal function affecting both drugs.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative analgesics such as acetaminophen.
